name: browser-policy
title_zh: 浏览器自动化前的最后一道闸门
tagline_zh: 不是所有网页都值得开浏览器。先走 CLI 和 API，默认无头新会话，只有登录墙才动用带身份的环境。
tagline_en: Not every page deserves a browser. Prefer CLI/API, default to fresh headless, escalate only on login walls, and.
desc_en: Browser-use policy for Pi agents. Use before any browser_* tool call. Prefer CLIs and APIs over browser automation, default to fresh headless sessions, escalate to the authenticated profile only on login walls, and never steal user focus.
why_zh: 把「能用浏览器」改成「该用才用」：默认无头、按需升级权限、禁止抢占焦点。
why_en: It forces the cheapest path first: headless by default, privilege only on demand, zero focus theft. Browser becomes the last.
limit_zh: 只约束 browser_* 调用，不覆盖文件读写或网络请求；若你的 Agent 必须全程登录态操作。
limit_en: Governs only browser_* calls, not file/network ops. If your agent needs persistent authenticated browsing, expect frequent manual confirmations.
title_en: The last gate before any browser automation
